{{Disambig|Keeper}}

==Enemies==
'''Keeper''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Void Keeper]], an that appears on Wave 36 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and on Wave 35 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode.

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Goal Keeper]], an enemy that apppeared on Wave 17 in [[Victory Field|Mission 3]] Easy and Hard difficulty during the [[Backyard Legends Event]].
*[[Gatekeeper (Krampus Frosthold)]], an enemy that apppeared on Wave 17 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] during the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]].
*[[Gatekeeper (Cold Ambush)]], an enemy that apppeared on Wave 20 in [[Cold Ambush]] during the [[Violent Night Event]].

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Gravekeeper]], a boss enemy that can summon [[Tombstone]]s and stun towers, first appeared on Wave 35 of the [[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]] modes.
